concerns.location: tasks.md:T005/T007 vs spec.md:FR-004, US-2 acceptance scenario 2
concerns.text: FR-004 mandates Type I error estimation 'by shuffling group labels multiple times with a fixed random seed' on the filtered real datasets (US-2 scenario 2: 'Given transformed data, When group labels are shuffled multiple times'). No task performs real-data label shuffling — T005/T007 estimate Type I error exclusively on simulated null data. The spec's named estimator has zero covering tasks; the tasks.md re-plan note claims 'the plan's methodological correction' but the plan (T021) in fact designates real-data shuffling as the PRIMARY FR-004 estimator. Either add a task implementing real-data label shuffling or record a spec amendment; as written, FR-004 is uncovered.

FR-003 requires applying the three transformations 'to each continuous variable' of the real datasets. T004 implements the transformation functions and verifies them on one dataset, but no subsequent task applies transformations to the real filtered datasets at scale or feeds real-dataset transformation results into testing/aggregation — T005/T006/T007 transform only simulated data. Real-dataset transformation outputs are never tested or aggregated, leaving FR-003 only partially covered.

FR-007 requires aggregation 'across all available datasets' computing mean Type I error and power 'for each transformation-test combination'; T006 computes power including the untransformed baseline, but T008 explicitly excludes baseline rows from aggregated_results.csv and adds a test enforcing their absence. The spec never authorizes baseline exclusion from the summary tables, so part of the FR-007/US-3 deliverable (baseline comparison rows) has no covering task.

FR-008 specifies the Friedman test as THE test assessing whether transformation type affects error rates; T009 demotes Friedman to 'a secondary check' and substitutes a binomial GEE model as primary. The Friedman test is still covered, but the spec's designated primary inferential procedure is re-scoped without a recorded spec amendment — the FR-008 requirement as written is only partially covered.

T007's validation gate uses an acceptance band [0.04, 0.06] for the baseline error rate; SC-002 specifies measurement against the nominal α = 0.05 with no such band. The band appears in neither spec nor plan — either justify it as a documented tolerance or align with SC-002.
α-sweep grid mismatch: plan T025 sweeps {0.01, 0.05, 0.10}; T009 sweeps {0.01, 0.02, 0.025, 0.05, 0.075, 0.10}. Both cover FR-008's 'range of small values', but the artifacts disagree; pick one grid.
